reading: Ed Sheeran's upcoming US concerts were called off because of imminent storm activity.
Performances initially planned for Friday and Saturday in Massachusetts were called off following extensive weather alerts.
The singer was to have given two concerts at the Gillette Stadium in Foxborough, near Boston, as part of his ongoing US tour.
Beyond the weather, the tour recently garnered significant attention regarding a dispute over removing Macklemore as a support act.
This action stemmed from Macklemore's pro-Palestinian comments made during previous stage appearances.
A statement indicated that, after consulting with local authorities, the tour organisers chose to suspend the events at Gillette Stadium.
This critical determination made the well-being of attendees, staff, and everyone involved in the productions paramount.
Those with tickets are able to secure reimbursement at their original point of acquisition.
High wind advisories remain in force across the region until early Sunday, prompting officials to recommend people minimise travel.
This was not the only difficult situation Sheeran navigated; he was at the eye of a storm last week concerning Macklemore's departure.
Robert Kraft, a stadium owner, lobbied for Macklemore's removal after Kraft accused the rapper of hate speech for his comments and showing images of Gaza.
Sheeran clarified that the choice to drop Macklemore was made by his tour management, not by him, with reports suggesting owners would not allow shows if Macklemore was on the bill.
Consequently, Macklemore's exclusion from the tour prompted other backing artists to pull out in solidarity, which sparked a heated debate on artistic freedom and political expression in music.
Upon returning to the stage, Sheeran expressed regret, acknowledging he had to make challenging choices and was making mistakes.

vocabulary.definition: likely to happen very soon; impending.
covering a large area or range; widespread.
gathered or acquired (something, especially attention or support).
a disagreement or argument, especially a formal one.
seeking information or advice from (someone with expertise or authority).
more important than anything else; supreme.
the action of repaying a person who has spent or lost money.
(of a law, rule, or advisory) operative; in effect.
reduce (something undesirable) to the smallest possible amount or degree.
the central point of a controversy, difficult situation, or crisis.
sought to influence (a politician or public official) on an issue; pressured for a particular outcome.
scheduled or listed as a performer for an event.
showed or stated that one felt sadness, repentance, or disappointment about something.
accepting or admitting the existence or truth of something.

entries.ja: 非常に近い将来に起こりそうなこと。差し迫っていること。
entries.ko: 아주 가까운 시일 내에 일어날 가능성이 있는; 임박한.
entries.zh-Hans: 很快就会发生的事情；即将发生的。
entries.es: Que es muy probable que ocurra muy pronto; inminente.
entries.pt-BR: Que tem grande probabilidade de acontecer muito em breve; iminente.

entries.ja: 広い範囲や領域を覆うこと。広範囲に及ぶこと。
entries.zh-Hans: 覆盖很大区域或范围的；广泛的。
entries.es: Que cubre una gran área o rango; extendido.
entries.pt-BR: Que cobre uma grande área ou gama; abrangente.

entries.ja: （特に注目や支持を）集めたり獲得したりした。
entries.zh-Hans: 收集或获得（某物，尤指关注或支持）。
entries.es: Recopiló o adquirió (algo, especialmente atención o apoyo).
entries.pt-BR: Reuniu ou adquiriu (algo, especialmente atenção ou apoio).

entries.ja: 意見の相違や議論、特に正式なもの。
entries.ko: 의견 불일치나 논쟁, 특히 공식적인 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 意见不合或争论，尤指正式的。
entries.es: Un desacuerdo o argumento, especialmente uno formal.
entries.pt-BR: Um desacordo ou discussão, especialmente um formal.

entries.ja: （専門知識や権限を持つ人から）情報や助言を求めること。
entries.ko: (전문성이나 권한을 가진 사람에게서) 정보나 조언을 구하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 向（具有专业知识或权力的人）寻求信息或建议。
entries.es: Buscar información o consejo de (alguien con experiencia o autoridad).
entries.pt-BR: Buscar informações ou conselhos de (alguém com experiência ou autoridade).

entries.ja: 他の何よりも重要であること。最高の。
entries.ko: 다른 어떤 것보다 더 중요한; 최고의.
entries.zh-Hans: 比其他任何事物都更重要；至高无上的。
entries.es: Más importante que cualquier otra cosa; supremo.
entries.pt-BR: Mais importante que qualquer outra coisa; supremo.

entries.ja: お金を使った、または失った人にお金を返す行為。
entries.ko: 돈을 썼거나 잃은 사람에게 돈을 갚는 행위.
entries.zh-Hans: 向已花费或损失金钱的人偿还款项的行为。
entries.es: La acción de reembolsar a una persona que ha gastado o perdido dinero.
entries.pt-BR: A ação de reembolsar uma pessoa que gastou ou perdeu dinheiro.

entries.ja: （法律、規則、勧告などが）有効であること。施行されていること。
entries.ko: (법률, 규칙 또는 권고 등이) 시행 중인; 유효한.
entries.zh-Hans: （指法律、规则或建议）生效的；有效的。
entries.es: (De una ley, regla o aviso) operativo; en efecto.
entries.pt-BR: (De uma lei, regra ou aviso) em vigor; em efeito.

entries.ja: （望ましくないもの）を可能な限り最小限の量や程度に減らすこと。
entries.ko: (바람직하지 않은 것을) 가능한 가장 적은 양이나 정도로 줄이다.
entries.zh-Hans: 将（不理想的事物）减少到最小可能数量或程度。
entries.es: Reducir (algo indeseable) a la menor cantidad o grado posible.
entries.pt-BR: Reduzir (algo indesejável) à menor quantidade ou grau possível.

entries.ja: 論争、困難な状況、危機の中心点。
entries.ko: 논란, 어려운 상황 또는 위기의 핵심 지점.
entries.zh-Hans: 争议、困难局面或危机的中心点。
entries.es: El punto central de una controversia, situación difícil o crisis.
entries.pt-BR: O ponto central de uma controvérsia, situação difícil ou crise.

entries.ja: ある問題について（政治家や公務員に）影響を与えようとした。特定の結果を求めて圧力をかけた。
entries.ko: 어떤 문제에 대해 (정치가나 공무원에게) 영향력을 행사하려고 시도했다; 특정 결과를 얻기 위해 압력을 가했다.
entries.zh-Hans: 试图就某一问题影响（一位政治家或公职人员）；为某一特定结果施加压力。
entries.es: Trató de influir (en un político o funcionario público) sobre un tema; presionó para un resultado particular.
entries.pt-BR: Procurou influenciar (um político ou funcionário público) sobre uma questão; pressionou por um resultado específico.

entries.ja: イベントの出演者として予定されている、またはリストに載っている。
entries.ko: 행사의 출연자로 예정되거나 명단에 올라 있는.
entries.zh-Hans: 被安排或列为某项活动的表演者。
entries.es: Programado o listado como artista para un evento.
entries.pt-BR: Programado ou listado como um artista para um evento.

entries.ja: 何かについて悲しみ、後悔、または失望を感じていることを示したり述べたりした。
entries.ko: 어떤 것에 대해 슬픔, 후회 또는 실망을 느꼈음을 보이거나 진술한.
entries.zh-Hans: 表示或说明对某事感到悲伤、悔恨或失望。
entries.es: Mostró o declaró que sentía tristeza, arrepentimiento o decepción por algo.
entries.pt-BR: Mostrou ou declarou que sentia tristeza, arrependimento ou desapontamento sobre algo.

entries.ja: 何かの存在や真実を受け入れること、または認めること。

entries.zh-Hans: 接受或承认某事的存在或真实性。
entries.es: Aceptar o admitir la existencia o verdad de algo.
entries.pt-BR: Aceitar ou admitir a existência ou a verdade de algo.
